answer_1.quote: In this paper, we investigate the LLM-guided conversation from framework design to autobiography interviewing applications.
datasets: An Autobiography by Catherine Helen Spence
answer_1.outputs: interview conversations and generated autobiography chapters

answer_2.quote: We define the Precision as the percentage of extracted events that are being verified as correct... We also adopt Recall and F1 as evaluation metrics.

answer_3.quote: We utilize the popular LLM-as-a-judge evaluation to make GPT-4 decide which conversation is better.

answer_4.quote: We also carry out human-involved experiments with 45 participants, prompting them to engage in conversations with GUIDELLM and baseline models.
answer_4.guideline: Participants indicated which model performed better, or it was a tie, and provided reasonings.
